blocks.html:
Requirements: Previous experience printing platinum palladium is required

This two-session course provides students with the opportunity to practice platinum palladium printing in a classroom setting. The first session begins with a review of the coating and processing steps, led by the instructor. The remainder of the course is dedicated to hands-on practice, allowing students to refine their coating and printing techniques. Print size is limited to 8x10. Students can expect to make between 6-8 prints during the course.

$75 materials fee included in tuition.

Jarrett Esaw is a photographer based in New York City, currently attending Hunter College for Studio Art. Interested in natural light, Jarrett explores New York in search of compositions and situations that stand out in different lighting. His work encompasses a variety of genres, with a focus on street photography. The print is an integral aspect of his practice. Whether it be silver gelatin, albumen, platinum, or inkjet his images are not fully realized until they are on paper.
